preconditions.description: The dimensions of the grid must be within the range of 1 to 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row in the grid must have exactly m elements.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in {'O', 'X'} for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid must be either 'O' or 'X'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of total 'X' shapes as a string.
